result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: one audit per twelve months, thirty days’ written notice, business-hours review, an independent auditor subject to written confidentiality obligations, Vendor-paid costs unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no system access. The revision is narrowly focused and preserves the remaining audit protections. However, it is not strictly minimal because Section 22.1 prohibits all access to Customer systems, while the playbook and existing Section 22.2 require only that there be no direct access. That broader and duplicative formulation should instead track Section 22.2 by stating that Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly.
